name: The Fool
description_general: You may feel a soft stir in your chest today, as if life is quietly inviting you into a new beginning. Give yourself room for curiosity and trust. You do not need the whole map. A first honest step with an open heart is enough.
description_love: In love you may feel a fresh breeze, as if your heart wants to open again. Look at the bond without old maps. The most beautiful connection often begins when you simply let yourself be real beside another person.
description_work: In work and money this card whispers of a new chapter. You may not have every answer yet, and that is all right. Trust the small spark of an idea. Give yourself permission to start with one tender step instead of waiting for a perfect plan.
description_reversed_general: You may feel unsteady, as if the ground is a little too soft. This is not failure. It is an invitation to slow down and ask what you truly need before you move. You are safer than you think.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may hesitate before opening your heart. Give yourself time. You do not have to promise everything today. Honest presence and gentleness with your own fear will do.
description_reversed_work: At work you may feel chaos or a lack of direction. Breathe. Tidy one small thing. You do not have to leap today. You can stand, look around, and choose a calmer path.

name: The Magician
description_general: You hold more power than you usually admit. Today you may feel that your words, hands, and intention truly create something. Look within and remember the gifts you already have. The world is waiting for your conscious gesture.
description_love: In love you can be the one who sets a tone of warmth and clarity. Your presence matters. If you want closeness, say so gently and plainly. A bond grows where someone reaches for contact with courage and care.
description_work: In work and money this card supports your agency. You can join an idea to an action. Do not scatter yourself across everything at once. Choose one thing you can actually move, and do it with full attention.
description_reversed_general: You may feel that your power has thinned, or that you are trying to control too much. This is a good moment to return to simplicity. You do not need to enchant the world. Trusting your true intention is enough.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may get lost in games or half-said things. Give yourself and the other person more truth. A warm, ordinary voice works better than a perfect image.
description_reversed_work: At work the tools may be there while the energy is not. Do not force brilliance. Start with one small, concrete step. Agency returns when you stop pretending you must be all-powerful.

name: The High Priestess
description_general: Today you may need silence more than advice from outside. Look within. Your intuition already knows something. It is only waiting for you to slow down enough to hear it. You do not have to explain everything. You can trust the quiet voice inside.
description_love: In love this card invites sensing rather than rushing. You may feel more than you say. Give the bond room for mystery and for tenderness that does not demand instant answers.
description_work: In work and money not everything can be settled by a spreadsheet today. You may sense which path is truer. Sit with it quietly before you decide. A wise move often grows in a pause, not in noise.
description_reversed_general: You may feel cut off from your intuition or lost in other voices. That does not mean you lost it. It is only muted. Give yourself quiet, breath, and a little solitude without guilt.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may stay silent from fear, not from wisdom. If something hurts or delights you, let a little of it come into the light. Closeness also needs gentle truth.
description_reversed_work: At work you may delay a decision while waiting for a sign that has already arrived. Trust what you know in your body. You do not need full proof to take the next calm step.

name: The Empress
description_general: You may feel that life wants to feed you, not only demand from you. Give yourself warmth, beauty, and softness. You are worthy of care, including the care you offer yourself. Blooming does not have to be loud. Sometimes a little tenderness and time are enough.
description_love: In love this card wraps you. You may long for closeness that nourishes instead of draining. Let yourself give and receive tenderness without keeping score. A bond flowers where there is body, warmth, and ordinary kindness.
description_work: In work and money you may gather fruit from earlier care. Create at a pace that does not wound you. Money and projects like to be tended like a garden: regularly, gently, with faith that growth will come.
description_reversed_general: You may feel empty, tired of giving, or cut off from pleasure. That is a signal to come home to yourself. Feed yourself with something simple: a warm meal, a walk, a soft word. You do not have to be a well for everyone today.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may give too much or lose your own needs. Remember that love does not require self-erasure. Your boundaries are a form of care as well.
description_reversed_work: At work you may be overloaded with care for everything and everyone. Hand some of it back. Your gift will not vanish when you rest. It will come alive again.

name: The Emperor
description_general: You may need a structure that carries you instead of squeezing you. You have the right to build a life where you feel safe. Notice where your inner adult can stand beside you with warmth, not with harshness.
description_love: In love this card speaks of stability and a responsible heart. You may want someone you can lean on, or you may become that presence yourself. Closeness likes clear frames and a tender word that is kept.
description_work: In work and money it helps to rest on a plan today. You can sort what has been scattered. Your consistency is a form of love for your future self. Act calmly, like someone building a home, not a castle of sand.
description_reversed_general: You may feel stiff, pressured, or tired of control. This is an invitation to loosen the grip. Strength does not have to be hard. You can steer your life more gently and still be responsible.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may defend yourself with rules instead of heart. Try to hear the other person without needing to win. Safety also grows from flexibility.
description_reversed_work: At work you may hold everything too tightly. Trust the process and the people where you can. Giving away a little control is not chaos. It may be relief.

name: The Hierophant
description_general: You may be looking for meaning larger than daily hurry. Notice which values you truly want to honor. You do not have to copy someone else path. You can take from tradition what feeds you and leave what constricts you.
description_love: In love this card speaks of trust, promises, and a shared language. You may want a bond with roots. Talk about what is sacred for you both: loyalty, tenderness, a shared rhythm.
description_work: In work and money a proven path, a mentor, or a clear principle can help today. You do not have to invent everything from zero. You can lean on what has already been wisely arranged and add your human voice.
description_reversed_general: You may resist rules, or feel lost when old beliefs no longer fit. This is ripening, not revolt for its own sake. Give yourself permission to ask what you actually believe today.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may feel trapped in expectations. Speak about it gently. Love does not have to look like a script from outside. It can look like your shared truth.
description_reversed_work: At work rigid procedures may wear you down. Look for meaning in what you do, not only obedience. If something no longer serves, you can name it and seek a more living way.

name: The Lovers
description_general: Today the heart may face a choice that belongs to more than the mind. Look at what agrees with your truth. Love of life begins with consent to be yourself. Choose what joins you, not what splits you.
description_love: In a relationship you may feel a deep pull or a need for an honest talk about who you are to each other. Give yourself courage to speak from the heart. Real closeness is born where two people choose each other on purpose.
description_work: In work and money this card asks about alignment. Is what you do in tune with you? You may stand before a fork in the road. Choose the path where you breathe more freely, even if it asks for courage.
description_reversed_general: You may feel torn, hesitant, or afraid to choose. You do not have to settle everything today. Sit with the question: what is my truth, and what is only habit? The answer will arrive more gently than you think.
description_reversed_love: In love there may be misunderstanding or a sense that you stand on two sides. This is not the end. It is an invitation to hear each other again without accusation.
description_reversed_work: At work a choice may freeze you. Break it into smaller questions. You do not have to betray yourself in order to be responsible. You can seek a path that honors both heart and reality.

name: The Chariot
description_general: You may feel a will to move forward today. You have the right to want and to act. Hold the reins with tender firmness. Your direction matters when heart and will travel the same way.
description_love: In love this card supports a brave approach or a clear saying of where you want to go. Do not shove. Lead. A bond likes it when someone knows what they desire and names it with respect.
description_work: In work and money you can speed up with meaning today. Focus on the aim and do not spill energy sideways. Warm persistence becomes a force that truly moves things.
description_reversed_general: You may feel pulled between desires or without a steering wheel. Stop the chariot for a moment. You do not have to win the day. It is enough to find your direction again.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may rush or pull back. Ask whether the other person is traveling with you or falling behind. Slow down so you can ride together again.
description_reversed_work: At work haste may scatter you. Return to one goal. If something brakes you, it is not to break you. It is so you can hold the reins better.

name: Strength
description_general: Your true power does not have to shout. Today you can tame a hard feeling with warmth, not with a fight. Look at yourself with tenderness. You carry a courage that can be soft and, because of that, remarkable.
description_love: In love this card speaks of patience and gentle bravery. You can love without devouring and without running. Give the bond time. Tender persistence heals more than a sudden gesture.
description_work: In work and money you can handle more than you fear if you stop lashing yourself. Act calmly, with faith in your rhythm. Strength is also the skill of not surrendering to your inner harsh judge.
description_reversed_general: You may feel weak, or the opposite: too hard on yourself. Both states ask for the same thing: kindness. You do not have to prove toughness today. You can simply be a person in process.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship fears, jealousy, or fatigue may surface. Treat them like an animal that needs stroking, not punishment. A conversation in a soft voice changes a great deal.
description_reversed_work: At work you may doubt your stamina. Take the pressure of being tough off your shoulders. Do smaller portions. Gentle regularity is braver than one burst.

name: The Hermit
description_general: You may need a light you carry for yourself. This is not escape. It is a meeting with your own wisdom. Give yourself quiet, a walk, a question without hurry. An answer likes to arrive when no one is shouting.
description_love: In love you may need breath or a deeper talk in calm. Not every pause is rejection. Sometimes someone steps aside for a while to return more true.
description_work: In work and money it helps not to chase the crowd today. Check your own criteria. A wise decision often grows far from everyone opinion.
description_reversed_general: You may feel a loneliness that stings a little. You do not have to sink in it. You can name it and look for one warm contact when you are ready. Your lantern does not go out, even when tiredness dims it.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship distance can be misread. Say that you need space, not disappearance. A tender explanation protects the bond.
description_reversed_work: At work isolation may cut you off from help. If you are lost, you may ask someone for a quiet word of counsel. Wisdom likes to be shared too.

name: Wheel of Fortune
description_general: Life may turn the scene a little today. That is not always disaster. Sometimes it is an invitation to move with a new rhythm. You cannot steer the whole wheel, but you can choose how you stand on it: with fear or with an open hand.
description_love: In love there may be mood shifts, meetings, or turns you did not plan. Receive them with curiosity. Bonds have seasons too. None of them stays in the same shape forever.
description_work: In work and money the wheel may bring a chance or a rearranged plan. Stay alert, not tight. Flexibility is your ally today. What leaves often makes room for something alive.
description_reversed_general: You may feel that nothing depends on you. That is a heavy feeling. Breathe. Even in change you still have your breath, your word, and the next small choice. The wheel also turns toward brighter places.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship uncertainty can wear you down. Do not build a whole house on one swing. Talk about what you feel now, without forecasting the worst.
description_reversed_work: At work a change of plans may knock you off center. List what you can influence. Leave the rest to the wheel. You do not have to carry all of fate alone.

name: Justice
description_general: Today you may need clarity and honesty, first of all with yourself. Look at the situation without polish and without cruelty. Truth offered with warmth settles the heart. You have a right to balance.
description_love: In love this card asks for sincerity and mutuality. Do you give and receive in a similar measure? Talk about it without a trial. A bond breathes when both sides feel seen.
description_work: In work and money it helps to close things cleanly: agreements, boundaries, accounts. Your fairness is a form of respect for yourself. You do not have to be hard. Being clear is enough.
description_reversed_general: You may feel that something is unfair, or that you are too severe a judge of yourself. Soften the sentence. Justice also has the face of understanding. Give yourself the right to be human.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may keep a tally of hurts or avoid a hard talk. Choose a third way: quietly naming facts and feelings. That heals more than silence.
description_reversed_work: At work vagueness can drain you. Ask for specifics. If something is not fair, name it plainly. You have a right to care for balance, not only for peace at any cost.

name: The Hanged Man
description_general: You may feel that life has hung you between one shore and another. This is not punishment. It is another angle of seeing. Give yourself consent not to push. Sometimes the largest movement happens in stillness.
description_love: In love you may need to turn the picture around. How does this bond look through the other person eyes? How does your heart look when you stop fighting for pace? A pause can be tender.
description_work: In work and money haste will not help much today. You can wait for a clearer signal. Use the time to think about meaning, not to panic. Releasing control can be wisdom.
description_reversed_general: You may feel frustration that nothing is moving. That tiredness is real. You do not have to pretend calm. You can simply soften the demand on the day and let one thing wait.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship the hanging can hurt. Say that you need time to understand, not to leave. A tender pause is different from a cold wall.
description_reversed_work: At work a stall may wake fear about money and place. Do only what is necessary. Leave the rest. Sometimes wisdom comes when you stop yanking a door that is meant to open on its own.

name: Death
description_general: Something in you may be reaching an end so that something truer can be born. It does not have to be drama. It can be a quiet close of a season. Give yourself the right to release what no longer feeds you. Life on the other side of change still likes you.
description_love: In love a certain stage may be ending: a way of being, an illusion, an old heart contract. You may be saying goodbye to a form, not necessarily to a person. Or you may leave a bond with respect. Both paths can be human.
description_work: In work and money this card often closes a project, a role, or a way of earning. Do not cling. What leaves makes space. Allow grief and curiosity about what is new.
description_reversed_general: You may fear an ending more than life itself. That is understandable. You do not have to bury everything today. It is enough to stop artificially keeping alive what has already gone. Breathe. You are in a passage, not in a void.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may feel grief, chill, or the sense that change is coming. Speak about it like adults with a soft voice. Endings deserve dignity, not a vanishing without a word.
description_reversed_work: At work fear of loss may freeze you. Take one practical step: tidy, close, ask. The future does not require you to pretend you feel nothing.

name: Temperance
description_general: Today you can mix contrary waters in yourself until something calm appears. You do not have to choose an extreme. Give yourself a rhythm that heals. Gentle blending is an art, not a weakness.
description_love: In love this card whispers of patiently matching temperatures. You can come closer without flooding the other person and without hiding. Look together for a warm middle.
description_work: In work and money measure and a steady flow help today. Not everything at once. Small, regular gestures will arrange more than a violent burst. Your life likes to be mixed slowly.
description_reversed_general: You may feel unsteady or impatient with the lack of an instant result. That is all right. Return to one simple ritual of balance: breath, water, a short walk. Harmony returns in small sips.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship swings of mood may tire you. You do not have to solve the whole story today. You can only soften the tone and find one shared gesture of kindness.
description_reversed_work: At work extremes may swing you between too much and emptiness. Cut extra hours, or do one concrete thing. Look for measure, not an ideal.

name: The Devil
description_general: You may see today what you have gripped so tightly that it feels tight. This is not a verdict. It is light pointed at a chain. Look with tenderness: which need stands behind this habit? You are larger than the loop you sometimes stand in.
description_love: In love a strong desire, jealousy, or fear of loss may appear. Do not shame yourself. Name it. Passion is beautiful when it does not imprison. Closeness likes room to breathe.
description_work: In work and money you may feel bound to status, pressure, or a way of earning that drains you. You have the right to ask whether this is still your path. Seeing the chain is already the beginning of looseness.
description_reversed_general: You may feel shame or the sense that something holds you more tightly than usual. You are not bad. You are a person who needs support and a gentler pace of leaving. One small act of freedom is enough for today.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may be turning in an old dance of control and hunger. Stop the music for a moment. Say what you are truly afraid of. Under fear there is often a need to be loved.
description_reversed_work: At work you may be tired of a loop of duties. Step away from comparing yourself with others for a moment. Ask what is truly necessary and what only feeds the fear that you are not enough.

name: The Tower
description_general: Something that was too rigid may crack today. That can be startling and, at the same time, it can open the air. You do not have to rebuild the whole structure in one night. First sit somewhere safe and breathe. After the storm the horizon is more true.
description_love: In love an illusion or an old wall may fall. That hurts, and it can also let truth in. If you talk, speak plainly and quietly. A bond that survives honesty often becomes more alive.
description_work: In work and money a sudden change may overturn a plan. First tend the ground: safety, facts, support. Then you rebuild. The tower falls, but you are not the tower. You are a person who can start from the foundation.
description_reversed_general: You may feel shock, anger, or emptiness after what collapsed. You have a right to that. Do not force instant growth. Dress what hurts and let a new shape arrive slowly.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a fight or a sudden discovery may leave you both stunned. Do not make irreversible choices in the fire. Safety first, then conversation.
description_reversed_work: At work a crisis may wake panic. Make a list: what is still whole, what needs repair, whom to ask for help. You are not alone with the rubble. Something more honest can be built from this.

name: The Star
description_general: After a harder stretch you may feel a quiet hope, like water poured on thirsty ground. Trust that light. It does not have to be large. It is enough that it is there. You are being guided more gently than the mind can name.
description_love: In love this card brings soothing and honest tenderness. You may believe again that closeness can heal. Give the bond a little nakedness of soul: no posing, with faith that you are worthy of warmth.
description_work: In work and money a brighter trail appears. You can create from inspiration, not only from pressure. Trust the vision even if it is still fragile. Small faithful steps feed a great star.
description_reversed_general: You may feel that hope is thin as a thread. Hold it anyway. You do not have to be full of shine. One calm gesture of faith in yourself is enough: a glass of water, a request for help, a sentence said under the breath.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may fear opening again. That is understandable. Open a little, not all the way. The star does not ask for haste. It asks for truth.
description_reversed_work: At work doubt may hide the meaning. Remember why you began. Even if the result is far away, your spark of work still counts.

name: The Moon
description_general: Today you may walk through a land of hunches, dreams, and uncertainty. Not everything has to be sharp. Look at your fears as shadows by the road, not as verdicts. Your intuition still shines, even when the mind is foggy.
description_love: In love there may be half-said things, longing, or projections. Before you assume, ask. A tender question clears fog better than an accusation.
description_work: In work and money not everything is clear today, and that is not your fault. Do not sign large decisions in a half-sleep. Gather more light. Meanwhile trust small, proven steps.
description_reversed_general: You may feel fear, muddle, or the sense that something is hidden. Hold that tiredness kindly. You do not have to unravel the whole night today. Leave yourself a lamp: breath, a note, a talk with someone kind.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship uncertainty may write stories in the head. Check them in reality. The other person is not your dream. They are a human you can ask.
description_reversed_work: At work fog may freeze you. Set large moves aside. Do what is simple and true. Clarity returns when body and sleep receive a little care.

name: The Sun
description_general: You may feel that life wants to warm you today. Allow joy without explaining it. You are visible and worthy of light. Simple gratitude for breath, body, and this one bright moment is enough for the heart to unfurl.
description_love: In love this card carries warmth, honesty, and a wish to be together in daylight. Show yourself. Do not hide your liveliness. A bond flowers when both people can laugh and be real.
description_work: In work and money energy may be brighter and results more visible. Act with trust. Your work deserves to be shown. Success does not have to be heavy. It can be warm.
description_reversed_general: You may feel that the glow is there but you cannot take it in, or that joy is fragile. That is all right. Take the sun in small doses. You do not have to be euphoric. It is enough to allow a little lightness.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may fear that brightness will show too much. And yet that nakedness in the light is what builds trust. Say one true, warm sentence.
description_reversed_work: At work you may not trust good results or fear they are only brief. Receive what is good without an instant tally. You are allowed to enjoy your own part.

name: Judgement
description_general: You may hear an inner call to rise into a more true life. This is not a harsh court. This is an awakening. Look at what in you wants to be called back to life. You have the right to begin again with what you have learned.
description_love: In love a conversation may come that sets everything in clear light: forgiveness, a decision, a new stage. Listen to the heart and to the story you have already lived. A return to each other is possible when an honest call is spoken.
description_work: In work and money you may feel that an old role is too tight. Answer the calling, even if it is quiet. Your experience was not wasted. It is time to gather it and use it on purpose.
description_reversed_general: You may feel judged or you may settle accounts with yourself without mercy. Change the sentence into understanding. Awakening does not require shame. It requires consent that you can be more than your hardest hour.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship old wounds may return to be named. Do not shut the door before you listen. Forgiveness, if it comes, let it be a choice, not a demand.
description_reversed_work: At work fear of being judged may block you. Remember why you do this. You can correct course without erasing yourself. You are in a process, not on trial.

name: The World
description_general: You may feel a great circle closing. You are in something complete, even if it is not perfect. Thank the road. You stand where both the beginning and the arrival can be seen. This is a good moment to hold your whole life with tenderness.
description_love: In love this card speaks of a mature fullness: being together and being yourself. You can celebrate what you already know how to give each other. A bond that dances in a full circle does not have to pretend that nothing hurts. It can carry it all.
description_work: In work and money a cycle may be completing: a project, a stage, a sense of your own worth. Close it with dignity. Only then open new doors. Fullness likes to be noticed.
description_reversed_general: You may feel that a last piece is missing, or that you do not know how to celebrate. Give yourself the right to admit how far you have already come. Completeness does not mean a lack of longing. It means you can rest in who you already are.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may be close to a goal and tired of the road at the same time. Hold that tiredness. You do not have to seal anything by force today. Shared presence is enough.
description_reversed_work: At work an unfinished edge may irritate you. List what is already ready. The rest can wait. Your worth does not depend on a last stamp.

name: Ace of Wands
description_general: A new spark may catch fire inside you. It is a fresh wish to live, create, and move. Do not snuff it with analysis. Give it air. You can begin something that truly lights you, even with the smallest gesture.
description_love: In love you may feel a sudden liveliness, attraction, or a wish to reach out again. This is an invitation, not an order. Speak of your fire gently. A spark likes to be welcomed, not smothered.
description_work: In work and money an idea or energy for a start appears. Catch it. You do not need a full plan. The first act that matches your enthusiasm is enough.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the spark fading before it fully caught. Do not blame yourself. You may need rest or another kind of fire. Look for what livens you even a little, without the pressure of a grand launch.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship desire may be muted by shame or fatigue. Give body and heart time. Desire returns when you feel safe.
description_reversed_work: At work a lack of muse is not the end of the road. Step down from the pedestal of inspiration. Do one simple thing. Motion often lights what force cannot.

name: Two of Wands
description_general: You stand on a threshold and look farther than usual. You can plan with courage and with tenderness for what you already have. The world is wider than the everyday room. You have the right to dream of it in concrete terms.
description_love: In love you may talk about a shared future or whether your roads want to go together. This is a mature moment. Speak of vision, not of ultimatums.
description_work: In work and money it is time for strategy. You can look beyond the known yard. Do not jump into the dark. Choose a direction and take the first considered step.
description_reversed_general: You may feel trapped in planning and afraid to step out. That is common. Come down from the tower for a while. Talk with someone kind. The decision does not have to be heroic. It can simply be next.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship hesitation about going further together can wear you down. Do not leave the other person guessing. Say that you need time to look at the horizon.
description_reversed_work: At work looking around without motion frustrates. Choose one option to test. A test is kinder than endless wavering.

name: Three of Wands
description_general: Your ships may already be on the water. Today you can look with hope, not with tension. Trust what you sent into the world. Widening the horizon also happens when you stand and wait with attention.
description_love: In love the bond may move onto wider water: shared plans, openness, more space as two. Enjoy that growth. Do not pull the sails down from fear.
description_work: In work and money earlier actions begin to show. Be ready to receive what returns. This is a good moment for collaboration and for a further, brave, yet calm widening of the field.
description_reversed_general: You may not see fruit yet and start to doubt. Waiting hurts. Breathe. Check that you have done your part, then give the world a moment. Not everything returns on your calendar.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may be growing at different speeds. Honor that. You can wait for each other with love, not with grievance.
description_reversed_work: At work a delay does not cancel the direction. Correct the course if needed, but do not burn the map. Your vision still has worth.

name: Four of Wands
description_general: You may feel that you are allowed to celebrate. Home, a threshold, community, a brief roof over the heart. Give yourself joy in what already stands. Not every stability is dull. Sometimes it is simply warm.
description_love: In love this card smells like a feast for two or like coming back to someone as to a home. Treasure ordinary safety. It is a rare gift.
description_work: In work and money a stage worth marking may arrive: a milestone, teamwork, a sense of belonging. Do not rush on at once. Stand and tell yourself that what you built counts.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the feast is incomplete or that you have nowhere to return. That is honest and sore. Make yourself a small threshold: tea, a flower, a call to someone kind. Home begins with a gesture.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may miss each other in hopes for a shared life. Talk about what your home should feel like, not only the one of bricks, but the one of feeling.
description_reversed_work: At work a lack of recognition may sadden you. Recognize yourself. If the climate is cold, look for people with whom your work has flavor.

name: Five of Wands
description_general: You may feel friction, clashing views, a little noise around you. This does not have to be war. Sometimes life is simply training your stance. Enter it with humor and without a need to crush anyone.
description_love: In love sparks or different temperaments may appear. Do not flee at once. Try to hear what sits under the argument. Often both of you want to matter.
description_work: In work and money competition or team chaos may tire you. Keep your fire, but do not burn bridges. Your idea defends itself better when you offer it calmly.
description_reversed_general: You may be tired of fighting for every inch. You are allowed to leave the arena. Not every dispute deserves your blood. Choose what is truly worth the energy.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship fights may repeat. Stop the form, change the tone. Asking what you really want the other to hear opens a door.
description_reversed_work: At work scattered force weakens the result. Stop putting out every fire. Choose one front and stand there with grace.

name: Six of Wands
description_general: You may hear a quiet bravo from the world or from yourself. Let yourself receive recognition. You do not have to shrink your effort. You are visible and that is all right. Walk on with a lifted, warm head.
description_love: In love someone may finally see you, or you may dare to show feeling. Receive the compliment. A bond likes it when one person success is a feast for both.
description_work: In work and money this card favors appreciation, a lift of spirit, a good result. Share the credit if you were not alone. Your light does not fade when it lights others too.
description_reversed_general: You may feel recognition passing you by, or that success tastes empty. That hurts. Do not build a story that you are invisible. Do something you can be proud of without a crowd.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship envy of someone else glow may appear. Talk about the need to be seen. Both of you deserve a cheer.
description_reversed_work: At work a lack of applause does not cancel the work. Write down what you did well. Your wheel turns without fanfare too.

name: Seven of Wands
description_general: You may feel you are defending your place, and that is noble. You have the right to stand by what matters. You do not have to fight everyone. Choose what you truly want to keep and stand there with dignity.
description_love: In love you may defend a boundary or a bond from outside pressure. Do it without digging a trench. Say what is sacred and invite the other person to stand beside you, not across from you.
description_work: In work and money pressure, critique, or competition may ask for a stance. Keep your standard. You are farther along than the attackers think. Breathe between parries.
description_reversed_general: You may be exhausted by constant defense. You are allowed to set the shield down for a night. Not everything that approaches is an attack. Some of it is simply life wanting a conversation.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a sense of siege can close the heart. Check whether you are defending yourself or an old wound. A partner is not always an opponent.
description_reversed_work: At work fighting every opinion drains you. Answer what is useful. Leave the rest behind the hill. Your place will not fall from one comment.

name: Eight of Wands
description_general: Things may speed up today, like arrows in the air. That is exciting if you keep your breath. Receive the movement. Answer when life writes. Flow likes it when you do not brake it with fear.
description_love: In love a message, a meeting, or a sudden turn of feeling may arrive fast. Be present. Do not analyze every spark to death. Sometimes the heart simply speeds up, and that is beautiful.
description_work: In work and money the pace rises: news, deadlines, chances. Sort in flight, do not panic. One thing after another. Your agility is a gift now.
description_reversed_general: You may feel chaos, delay, or that everything flies too fast for your nerves. Ask for a pause. You have the right to slow one arrow. Not everything must happen by tonight.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship haste can lose tenderness. Write, call, and also leave room for the other person breath.
description_reversed_work: At work a flood of tasks overwhelms. Choose three that matter most. The rest can wait in the quiver. Speed without choice tires.

name: Nine of Wands
description_general: You may be tired and still on watch. I see that endurance. You are closer to the end of a stage than you feel. Tend the bruises, but do not give up your post from a habit of quitting. Your caution today is wisdom, not cowardice.
description_love: In love you may be raw after earlier wounds. That is understandable. Say that you need time to trust again. You do not have to be open all the way in order to be loving.
description_work: In work and money the last stretch may be the heaviest. Hold on. Ask for support if the shield is too heavy. Finishing is closer than a new war.
description_reversed_general: You may feel you cannot take another round. That is not weakness. It is the body asking for rest. Take the armor off for an hour. The world will not fall, and you will return more present.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a defensive stance may read as coldness. Explain that it is fatigue, not a lack of love. Ask for gentleness.
description_reversed_work: At work burnout hides behind the last duty. Share the watch. Endurance does not mean you must stand on the wall alone.

name: Ten of Wands
description_general: You are carrying a great deal. I see it. You do not have to prove you can take it all. Some of the load can be set down, some handed over, some finished so you can breathe. You are worth more than the sum of your burdens.
description_love: In love you may carry the bond alone or stay silent so as not to weigh on the other person. That exhausts you. Say what is too heavy. Love likes to be carried by two.
description_work: In work and money overload is a signal, not a medal. Delegate, decline, close. A success that bends you to the ground is asking for another form.
description_reversed_general: You may be so tired you no longer see the aim. Stop. Set down one bundle. Then another. Relief arrives in layers, not in one heroic gesture.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship silent carrying breeds resentment. It is kinder to say early that you need help than to break in silence.
description_reversed_work: At work the list is never finished. Choose what truly must arrive today. The rest is not your destiny. It is only a list.

name: Page of Wands
description_general: A curious young fire is waking in you. You may want to learn, write, travel, try. Do not put out that flush. The world is full of messages meant for you. Answer with enthusiasm and the humility of a beginner.
description_love: In love you may feel a fresh fascination or a wish to send a brave, even clumsy message. That is charming. Be honest more than smooth. A spark likes truth.
description_work: In work and money study, a new subject, a first contact appears. Do not play the expert. Be a living student. That opens doors that showy certainty will not.
description_reversed_general: You may feel scattered, raw zeal, or shame that you are only beginning. Beginning is beautiful. Do not compare your Page to someone else King.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship haste may outrun care. Slow down for one sentence. Zeal with gentleness is charming.
description_reversed_work: At work ideas may outnumber endings. Choose one letter to send. The rest of the sparks can wait in the hearth.

name: Knight of Wands
description_general: You may want to charge forward with fire in the chest. That is wonderful energy when it has a direction. Move, but also look at whom you leave in the dust. Your passion is a gift when it does not burn bridges.
description_love: In love the pull may be intense, fast, almost cinematic. Enjoy it and ask whether the other person rides at the same pace. Heat is beautiful when it is mutual.
description_work: In work and money a bold move, a journey, a pitched idea is favored. Act before it cools. Watch that the zeal has a plan for tomorrow, not only for today.
description_reversed_general: You may feel impatience, leaving things half done, or burning out. Get off the horse for a night. Passion will return. Right now it needs water, not another gallop.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship haste may wound even without bad will. Apologize for the pace, not for the fire. Then listen.
description_reversed_work: At work jumping from project to project tires you and others. Finish one stretch. A knight who can also stand is stronger in the best sense.

name: Queen of Wands
description_general: You may stand in your warmth and glow today without apology. Your presence heats the room when you are yourself. Do not hide the fire to make someone more comfortable. Shine kindly and proudly. You are allowed.
description_love: In love this card favors a magnetic, warm confidence. You can attract by being alive, not by playing. Show your yes with humor and a spine.
description_work: In work and money your charm and creativity want to be seen. Lead with warmth. People follow someone who believes in their own fire and still sees others.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the glow has dimmed, or envy that others shine. That is human. Return to what lights you in private, without a stage. Your queen has not vanished. She is resting.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship you may overwhelm with temperament or, the opposite, put yourself out. Look for measure. Closeness likes your fire when it leaves room for a second flame.
description_reversed_work: At work doubt about your presence and skill is only a shadow. Do one thing as your full self. Confidence returns in action, not in a mirror.

name: King of Wands
description_general: You can lead with vision today, not with a whip. You hold a mature fire: the kind that warms a whole field, not only your own hand. Trust the direction and invite others to walk with you, not behind you in silence.
description_love: In love this card speaks of a generous, brave heart that can also stay. You can want and give space. That is a rare pairing. Guard it.
description_work: In work and money it is time for bold, grown decisions. You see farther. Act like someone who takes responsibility for the climate, not only the result. Your enthusiasm is contagious when it is ethical.
description_reversed_general: You may feel a leader burnout or a haste that outruns wisdom. Step off the throne for a while. A king who rests does not lose the crown. He recovers clarity.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship the need to lead may turn into steering. Ask where the other person wants to go. A shared hearth is warmer than yours alone.
description_reversed_work: At work the pressure of vision may stiffen you. Delegate some of the heat. Not everything must come from your head to carry your good mark.

name: Ace of Swords
description_general: Through the fog a sharp, clean light of understanding may pass today. You have the right to see a matter as it is. Truth, even if it stings at first, later frees. Take this sword carefully and use it to cut a knot, not a person.
description_love: In love a clear word may fall that sets everything in place. Speak precisely and gently. Honesty is a gift when it is not a weapon. A bond breathes after truth if the truth has a heart.
description_work: In work and money a clear decision, an idea, a contract, or a cut of the extra is favored. Think simply. Your mind is an ally today when it serves life, not only winning.
description_reversed_general: You may feel muddle or a sharpness that wounds you too. Set the sword down for the night. Tomorrow you will see more cleanly. Not every thought that arrives in tension is true.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship sharp words may already have fallen. Return to the same fact with a gentler voice. You can be clear without being cruel.
description_reversed_work: At work decision paralysis or too much analysis tires you. Write one truth you already know and act only from that. The rest of the fog will drop.

name: Two of Swords
description_general: You may have bound eyes, not from cowardice but from too much. Two arguments weigh the same and the heart is quiet. That is all right. Sit until the body hints. You do not have to split the world in half today.
description_love: In love you may avoid a talk so as not to hurt or be hurt. Blind calm is fragile. When you are ready, lift the cloth with someone you trust. Even by an inch.
description_work: In work and money a decision hangs. Gather missing facts, but do not hide behind them forever. Sometimes balance is only a pause before movement.
description_reversed_general: You may feel trapped between yes and no. Breathe. Take off the pressure of an instant verdict. You are allowed to say you do not know yet, and that is honest too.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship silence may be read as indifference. Name it: I need time to hear myself. That is kinder than a wall.
description_reversed_work: At work delay from fear of error makes the load larger. Choose the smaller harm as a trial. Decisions can be corrected. A stall less so.

name: Three of Swords
description_general: The heart may be sore today. You do not have to be brave. Sorrow that comes out is honest. Hold yourself. Tears are how the chest makes room for air. This will pass, and you will remain, more true.
description_love: In love a parting, words, absence, or disappointment may hurt. Do not drown it at once. Tell someone kind. Bonds teach through cracks too, even if you would have preferred another lesson.
description_work: In work and money a letdown, a rejection, or hard news may cut. Separate the fact from the story that you are unworthy. You are worthy. The situation is hard. Those are not the same.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the pain return in waves. That is normal. You are not broken. You are in grief for something that mattered. Give yourself small kindnesses: warmth, sleep, a slow day.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a wound may be old and suddenly open. Speak of the pain, not of blame, if you can. If you cannot, tend yourself first.
description_reversed_work: At work hard news does not define your whole road. Take a day to breathe if you can. Then see what remains whole.

name: Four of Swords
description_general: Your mind deserves to lie down in quiet. Rest today is not laziness. It is healing. Put the swords away. Dim the light. Let the nerves drop. You return from here clearer, not weaker.
description_love: In love you may need a break from analyzing the bond. Simply be, or give each other separate calm. Quiet together can also be closeness.
description_work: In work and money a chosen or forced pause will protect you from error born of exhaustion. Do not make large decisions on no sleep. Recovery is a strategy.
description_reversed_general: You may not know how to rest because thoughts will not sleep. That is tiring. You do not have to switch the mind off perfectly. A little fewer signals is enough. One calm ritual is a start.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship withdrawal may worry a partner. Say it is sleep for the nervous system, not coldness of feeling.
description_reversed_work: At work guilt about a pause is an extra weight. Your future clarity of mind will thank you for today stillness.

name: Five of Swords
description_general: You may be leaving a clash where someone won and everyone lost a little. Ask whether that win is needed. Sometimes the bravest act is to set the sword down and leave with dignity. Your peace is worth more than the last word.
description_love: In love sharp points, spite, or a need to be right may leave a residue. Apologize for the tone even if the content mattered. A relationship is not a battlefield.
description_work: In work and money conflict, intrigue, or an empty victory may leave a bitter taste. Choose honesty over triumph. The long road likes clean hands.
description_reversed_general: You may feel defeated or ashamed of how it went. You are not your worst exchange of words. You can return and repair the tone. Or you can leave and not reenter a toxic game.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a ledger of hurts darkens tenderness. Set the list aside and ask whether you still want to stand on the same side.
description_reversed_work: At work a climate of winning at others cost drains. Look for allies, not trophies. Your name is quiet capital.

name: Six of Swords
description_general: You may be crossing from a harder shore to a calmer one. This is not flight. It is a wise journey. Take what you need and leave the weight that no longer has to travel. The water under the boat is an ally today.
description_love: In love you may be leaving a stormy stage for quieter water. Or someone paddles away to heal. Honor the pace. A crossing needs quiet and trust in the direction.
description_work: In work and money a change of place, subject, or way of thinking may bring relief. Do not look back every moment. Row. Better conditions for the mind wait on the other side.
description_reversed_general: You may grieve the shore you leave, even if it hurt. That is human. You can travel and say goodbye at once. You do not have to be only grateful or only sad.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship distance on the journey may wake fear. Keep a thread of contact. Drifting is not always loss.
description_reversed_work: At work the unknown new shore may freeze you. Focus on the nearest stroke: one note, one file, one day.

name: Seven of Swords
description_general: Something may be happening at an angle: strategy, half-saying, a wish to leave by a side door. Before you judge yourself or others, ask what fear stands behind the move. You can choose a straighter road when you feel safer.
description_love: In love secrets, half-truths, or a sense that someone is not standing in full light may appear. Speak of the need for honesty without a hearing. Trust returns in small, consistent gestures.
description_work: In work and money it is worth checking details and your own shortcuts. Cleverness without ethics tires in the long run. Look for a solution you can sign with your name.
description_reversed_general: You may feel deceived or tempted to avoid a confrontation. Both states ask for safety. You do not have to reveal everything in public today. You can choose one more honest talk.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship hiding hurts more than a hard truth. Start with a small confession. A bridge is built plank by plank.
description_reversed_work: At work a sense that you must weave is a signal that the system or the role is squeezing you. Look for a clearer arrangement, even if it is slower.

name: Eight of Swords
description_general: You may feel bound by thoughts, as if the way out is covered. The path is often closer than the mind shows. Lift one cloth: one assumption that holds you. You are less trapped than this picture says.
description_love: In love you may stay silent because you fear the result of truth. Or you feel trapped in the bond only in the head. Check reality. A talk, even a quiet one, cuts some of the cords.
description_work: In work and money a sense of no choice can be stronger than the facts. Write what truly holds you. Some bars are made of thought. Some can be moved with help.
description_reversed_general: You may be so tired of fear that even freedom looks unsafe. That is understandable. You do not have to run. One knot loosened today is enough.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship mutual charges of imprisonment close both people. Offer a small freedom: a walk, an evening apart, a sentence without defense.
description_reversed_work: At work a spiral of analysis without motion deepens the cage. Ask someone outside for a look. Other eyes see a gate.

name: Nine of Swords
description_general: The night may be loud with worry. I see how hard it is when the mind will not sleep. You are not those thoughts. You are someone who bears them and deserves relief. Morning light is closer than this hour promises. Ask for help if the weight is too much.
description_love: In love unrest, scenarios, and regret may circle in the dark. Do not hold a hard talk at three in the morning. Write the thought and return to it in daylight, with a soft voice.
description_work: In work and money fear of tomorrow may enlarge the threat. Separate what is a fact for tomorrow morning from what is a film in the head. One practical step after sleep will do more than a whole night of analysis.
description_reversed_general: You may feel you cannot face another night. You are very tired and that matters. Reach for presence: a friend, a professional, a warm ritual. You do not have to come out of this alone.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship your fears may be taken personally. Explain that this is a wave in you, not a verdict on the bond. Ask for holding, not for solving everything.
description_reversed_work: At work circling a mistake or a lost place drains strength. Write the worst scene on paper and set it aside. Tomorrow you will weigh it with a clearer head.

name: Ten of Swords
description_general: Something may have reached an end in a way that hurts and leaves you breathless. This is the bottom of this story, not of your whole person. Lie still if you need to. Then, when the body allows, rise an inch. Dawn behind this picture has already begun, even if you cannot feel it yet.
description_love: In love a break of trust, a sudden end, or the sense that you can carry no more may hurt. Grief belongs here. Do not rush forgiveness. First truth and care for yourself.
description_work: In work and money a closing, a failed project, or a painful message may knock you down. This is a stage, not an identity. Secure the basics. You will rebuild the rest when breath returns.
description_reversed_general: You may feel that nothing good will come again. That is the voice of exhaustion, not an oracle. Stay with the nearest hour. Water, sleep, one kind person. The bottom is also a place from which you cannot fall farther.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship an ending may be obvious and still hard to believe. Give yourself a ritual of goodbye. You do not have to be strong for witnesses.
description_reversed_work: At work a fall does not cancel your skill. Gather what this story taught you without whipping yourself. Then a new, smaller beginning.

name: Page of Swords
description_general: Your mind may be alert, curious, a little windy today. You want to know, understand, ask. That is a beautiful student energy. Watch that curiosity does not turn into suspicion. A question asked with kindness opens a door.
description_love: In love you may analyze every signal. Try asking directly instead of tracking shadows. A fresh conversation is braver than a silent investigation.
description_work: In work and money study, research, and new information are favored. Gather facts. Do not issue a verdict yet. The Page is only practicing the sword. Let it stay light.
description_reversed_general: You may feel nervous, chatty in the head, or afraid that you do not know enough. That is normal at a start. You do not have to know everything to ask one wise question.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship too many questions can overwhelm. Leave room for an answer and for silence. Curiosity with respect is tender.
description_reversed_work: At work scattered gathering of facts delays the start. Choose one source, one subject. The rest of the knowledge will come on the road.

name: Knight of Swords
description_general: You may rush with a thought that wants to cut everything now. Your mind is sharp and brave. Use the brake on the turn. Speed without heart wounds. Speed with a clear aim frees.
description_love: In love sharp words or a sudden decision may outrun tenderness. If they already fell, return and soften. If not yet, take a breath before you speak. A relationship is not a debate to win.
description_work: In work and money fast, precise action can save the day. Move when the facts are with you. Do not move only because adrenaline likes wind.
description_reversed_general: You may regret a hasty cut or feel that others are too slow. Slow down long enough to count to three. Your sword will be truer when it does not shake from speed.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a need to be right leaves a chill. Choose being close over being sharper. That is harder and more beautiful.
description_reversed_work: At work a charge without consulting others falls on people. Say where you are going before you gallop. Then the team can keep up.

name: Queen of Swords
description_general: You may see clearly today, even through a grief that once taught you. Your insight is a gift when it stays with the human. Speak truth with dignity. You do not have to be hard to be wise. You can be both sharp and warm.
description_love: In love this card favors mature honesty and boundaries that protect the heart instead of closing it. Say what is clear for you. Leave the other person the right to their clarity.
description_work: In work and money your independent thinking is an asset. Cut what is extra. Judge fairly. Hold talks in which a fact does not destroy dignity.
description_reversed_general: You may feel cold, lonely in the mind, or a blade turned on yourself. Set the judge crown down. You deserve the same understanding you would give a wise friend.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship analysis may be read as a lack of feeling. Show that clarity is your way of loving. Add one soft sentence to every sharp one.
description_reversed_work: At work the isolation of the expert tires. Share knowledge without a weapon. Your worth does not fall when someone else understands too.

name: King of Swords
description_general: You may stand today with a clear principle and clean thinking. That does not have to be cold. A mature mind serves life. Make decisions you can explain without shame. Your word has weight. Use it like someone who cares for people.
description_love: In love this card speaks of honesty, grown boundaries, and a talk that does not flee into fog. You can love and think at the same time. That is not a contradiction. That is safety.
description_work: In work and money strategy, law, diagnosis, a hard but clean decision are favored. Separate emotional noise from the core. Then return to people with a conclusion offered humanly.
description_reversed_general: You may feel cut off from the heart or too severe in judgment. Take the crown off for the evening. A king who can decide nothing for one night returns wiser, not weaker.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship control through logic may put out closeness. Leave room for what cannot be proven and is true anyway: tenderness.
description_reversed_work: At work too much distance spoils a team. Explain why, not only what. A mind without a bridge to people becomes a castle.

name: Ace of Pentacles
description_general: Something tangible may appear in your hand: a chance, a seed, first money, a healthy yes from life. Receive it with humility and joy. Not everything precious shouts. Sometimes it simply lies in the palm and waits to be planted.
description_love: In love you may receive a chance at something stable, bodily, everyday. A bond needs ground too. Treasure gestures you can see: time, presence, a shared table.
description_work: In work and money a real opening appears. Do not dismiss a small start. Plant the seed in practice: an account, a contract, a first meeting. Matter likes to be treated seriously and warmly.
description_reversed_general: You may feel a chance passing you or that you do not deserve a tangible gift. That is an old wound, not a fact. Reach for what is small and true. The rest will grow.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a lack of concretes may frustrate. Ask for one visible gesture and offer one too. Love likes to have a body.
description_reversed_work: At work promises without ground tire. Look for what can be touched: a date, a number, a first step. A dream without soil withers.

name: Two of Pentacles
description_general: You may juggle many things today and still dance. That is an art, not proof that you should fall apart. Keep the rhythm. If something drops, pick it up without drama. Flexibility is your earthly wisdom.
description_love: In love you may balance different paces, homes, calendars. Do it with humor. A bond does not require a perfect timetable. It requires a wish to catch the ball again.
description_work: In work and money flows may rise and fall. Watch priorities and breath. You can carry more than you think if you do not lock your shoulders at every change of weight.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the juggling is too much. Set one ball down. That is not failure. It is a choice not to drop what truly matters. The body is part of this act too.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a lack of time may be read as a lack of love. Name the logistics. Then keep one sacred shared piece of the day.
description_reversed_work: At work a chaos of tasks blurs quality. Choose two things for today. The rest can lie. Rhythm returns when you stop pretending you can hold it all.

name: Three of Pentacles
description_general: You may build something together with others today. Your craft matters. You do not have to know everything. It is enough to bring your part with respect for someone else part. Shared work warms more than a lonely monument.
description_love: In love the bond is a shared building too. Treasure different gifts: one feels better, one organizes better. Praise each other for the contribution, not only the result.
description_work: In work and money collaboration, learning a craft, and calm feedback are favored. Show a sketch. Ask a master for an eye. Your worth grows in dialogue, not in hiding.
description_reversed_general: You may feel your contribution is unseen or that it is hard to enter the team. That hurts. Do your part well and name it calmly. You do not have to shout to exist in the building.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship the sense that you pull the build alone deserves a talk. Ask for a concrete contribution, not a vague change.
description_reversed_work: At work a chaos of roles spoils the wall. Agree who owns what. A clear split is tenderness toward the project and the people.

name: Four of Pentacles
description_general: You may hold what you have a little too tightly because the world once shook. That is understandable. Safety is a need, not a sin. Check only whether the grip still protects or already stops blood in the hand.
description_love: In love you may fear loss and therefore hold too hard or lock the treasury of feeling. Loosen a little. Closeness needs circulation, not only a lock.
description_work: In work and money saving and caution can be wise. Do not confuse them with a fear that invests nothing in life. Keep a cushion and one generous gesture toward yourself.
description_reversed_general: You may fear for resources or feel shame that you hold on. Both voices deserve understanding. You can protect the nest and open a window. That is not a contradiction.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship control over what is shared smothers. Trust a little. The other person is not your coin. They are a companion.
description_reversed_work: At work keeping everything to yourself blocks growth. Hand over a piece of responsibility. Resources like movement too.

name: Five of Pentacles
description_general: You may feel out in the cold, outside the window, as if help sits on the other side of the glass. I see that chill. You are worthy of coming inside. Ask. Receive. You are not a burden. You are a person in a harder season.
description_love: In love you may feel rejected or together against scarcity. Hold hands. Shared cold is lighter than lonely cold. If there is no bond, do not stand under a closed door forever.
description_work: In work and money fear of lack, a loss, or a shortage of resources may press. Seek real help: people, relief, a plan B. Pride is a thin coat in frost.
description_reversed_general: You may be ashamed of need. That shame lies. Everyone stands outside a window sometimes. Take one step toward light: a message, an application, a visit. Doors are often less closed than you think.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship feeling unseen burns. Say it plainly. If the other person does not open, your warmth deserves another place.
description_reversed_work: At work scarcity can freeze inventiveness. First a minimum of safety, then strategy. You do not have to be brilliant in the frost.

name: Six of Pentacles
description_general: An exchange may flow today: give, receive, level the scale. Generosity is beautiful when it does not wound the giver. Receiving is beautiful when it does not shrink the receiver. You can stand on both sides of this tender balance.
description_love: In love check mutuality. Can you both give and take? Ask for what you need and hear the other person request. Balance is tender, not a ledger.
description_work: In work and money this card favors fair pay, a grant, help, a just split. Do not work for free from habit. Do not give from above in order to feel better. Look for level ground.
description_reversed_general: You may feel used or awkward when you are the one in need. Both states ask for dignity. Giving and receiving should be human, not hierarchical.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship uneven energy hurts. Name it without charging stinginess. Sometimes someone does not know they take too much until they hear it.
description_reversed_work: At work unclear rules of pay drain trust. Ask for clarity. Your work has weight and deserves respect in numbers.

name: Seven of Pentacles
description_general: You stand over what you planted and weigh the growth. This is a wise pause, not laziness. Not everything ripens on your clock. You can improve the care and still trust the soil. Patience is a form of love for future fruit.
description_love: In love the bond may need time before it yields what you both want. Do not pull the roots to check if they live. Talk about what already shows above ground.
description_work: In work and money an investment of time may not yet return in full. Check whether the direction is right. If it is, continue calmly. If not, move one bed, do not burn the garden.
description_reversed_general: You may be impatient at the lack of harvest and ready to abandon it all. Understandable. Do a review, not a fire. Often a little more regular care is missing, not a whole new life from zero.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship comparing your growth with someone else garden saddens. Return to your own bed. What is already green with you?
description_reversed_work: At work doubt about whether the effort pays is loud. Count what has already grown, not only what is missing. Then decide with the soil, not with panic.

name: Eight of Pentacles
description_general: You may sit to a craft today with humility and satisfaction. Repetition is not a penalty. It is how a hand learns beauty. Polish one thing. Your care is tenderness toward the world and toward yourself.
description_love: In love the bond also wants daily practice: small gestures, a better tone, learning the other person. Mastery of closeness grows in repeats, not in grand declarations.
description_work: In work and money study, correction, and a solid workshop are favored. Do not flee into shine when something needs honing. Pay and respect like those who do not pretend they already know it all.
description_reversed_general: You may feel boredom, pressure to be perfect, or that your work is invisible. Pause for the body. Then return to one detail. You do not have to be a master tonight.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship mechanical repeating without heart grows cold. Put attention into an ordinary gesture. Quality of presence is your craft.
description_reversed_work: At work toil without learning tires. Change one tool, one method. Craft likes curiosity, not only sweat.

name: Nine of Pentacles
description_general: You may taste independence today and a garden you tended yourself. You are allowed to celebrate that. You are enough in your own skin. The benefits you have do not need to be explained. Enjoy them without guilt.
description_love: In love this card reminds you that you can be full on your own, and then a bond is a choice, not a crutch. Come to someone from a garden, not from a void. That is healthier for both.
description_work: In work and money the fruit of self-reliance shows. Manage it wisely and with pleasure. Luxury is also time and calm, not only a thing. Leave part of the harvest for beauty.
description_reversed_general: You may feel alone in your garden or ashamed that you are well when others are not. Invite someone for grapes. You do not have to give away the whole orchard to be a good person.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship independence may be read as distance. Show that your self-sufficiency does not close the gate. It opens it by choice.
description_reversed_work: At work rest from proving. You already have some ground under your feet. You can create from fullness, not from hunger for approval.

name: Ten of Pentacles
description_general: You may think of home in a wide sense: kin, heritage, long tables, safety across generations. What you build can last longer than your day. Give yourself the right to want roots and to leave something solid and good.
description_love: In love this card smells of a shared nest, a family of choice, lastingness. Talk about the home you want in hearts and in facts. Closeness likes to be written into a larger story.
description_work: In work and money long-term security, family collaboration, or building something that remains is favored. Think farther than this month, but do not carry the whole clan on your back alone.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the weight of tradition or the lack of the home you imagine. That longing deserves tenderness. Family and heritage can also be chosen and made from yourself.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship different visions of a shared life may clash. Listen to the other person roots. Then plant your own tree.
description_reversed_work: At work the pressure to provide everything for everyone is too much. Decide what you truly leave behind. Uncover the rest to other hands.

name: Page of Pentacles
description_general: You hold a seed and look at it seriously, like a student who truly wants to learn. That is beautiful. Begin slowly, exactly. The material world likes those who do not pretend they already harvest when they have only just sown.
description_love: In love you may be learning practical tenderness: how to be, how to care, how to show feeling in a deed. You do not have to be practiced. A sincere wish to learn the other person is enough.
description_work: In work and money a course, a first job, saving, a new habit is favored. Treat money and craft with a beginner respect. That opens the door to adulthood without hurry.
description_reversed_general: You may feel clumsy or too slow. Comparing kills the seed. Water yours. Others have other seasons.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship awkward gestures are charming when they are true. Do not rehearse love like a role. Practice presence.
description_reversed_work: At work a lack of experience is not shame. It is a stage. Ask a question. Make a note. A Page who asks grows faster.

name: Knight of Pentacles
description_general: You walk slowly and that is why you will arrive. Your solidity is an underrated kind of courage. You do not have to shine at a gallop. A field is plowed in rhythm. Today you are allowed to be the knight who does not leave the work mid-furrow.
description_love: In love this card speaks of fidelity in the everyday: I come, I do, I am here. It may not be a film, but it is a home. Treasure that in yourself and in the other person.
description_work: In work and money steadiness, kept dates, and cautious growth are favored. Do not speed up by force. Your name grows with every finished meter.
description_reversed_general: You may feel stall, stubbornness, or that life is only duty. Loosen the reins for one evening. A knight also dismounts to feel the grass. Tomorrow he plows again.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship predictability may be read as boredom. Show that constancy holds tenderness. Add one unexpected warm gesture to the routine.
description_reversed_work: At work a slow pace may irritate others. Explain your rhythm with facts. The quality you give defends itself when you let it arrive.

name: Queen of Pentacles
description_general: You may wrap life today in what is practical and warm: a meal, care, a wise household of the heart. Your earthliness is sacred. You do not have to choose between spirit and body. At your table the board is an altar of care.
description_love: In love this card favors nurturing, sensual, everyday closeness. You feed each other with presence. Remember to feed yourself too. A queen with an empty plate will not warm a house for long.
description_work: In work and money you can join result with care for people and resources. Run affairs like a good garden. Nothing is wasted when you have eye and heart at once.
description_reversed_general: You may be tired of caring for everyone and everything. Hand over part of the pantry. You are not the only source of food in the area. Your body is a subject that needs feeding too.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship giving may become your only speech of love. Ask to be served with tenderness as well. That is not a whim. That is balance.
description_reversed_work: At work being the host of everything ends in emptiness. Set hours for harvest and hours for closing the garden.

name: King of Pentacles
description_general: You may stand on land you made fertile and share the harvest without fear. Mature prosperity has a warm face. Your stability can be a gift for others when it does not turn into control. Build so that people can breathe under your roof.
description_love: In love this card speaks of a partner you can lean a day on: generous, sensual, present in facts. Be that and look for that. Safety is closeness in the best human sense.
description_work: In work and money management with class, investment, and finishing large earthly matters are favored. Think like someone who leaves an orchard, not only a season. Ethics and gain can walk together.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the weight of being a rock for everyone or an attachment to status. Come down from the pedestal into the garden. A king who can own nothing for one evening returns healthier.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship providing everything may drown feeling. Leave the fortune outside the bedroom door. There skin and voice count, not the storehouse.
description_reversed_work: At work watching every coin smothers growth. Trust the people at your table. A kingdom is larger than one pair of hands.

name: Ace of Cups
description_general: The heart may overflow with fresh water today. It is a new stream of feeling, compassion, soul-making. Do not close the cup from fear it will spill. You can love life again, from the first sip.
description_love: In love a spring opens: a new feeling or a renewal of an old one. Receive it softly. You do not have to name the whole ocean at once. The first taste is enough.
description_work: In work and money emotional meaning returns to what you do. Create from the heart, not only from duty. People feel when something is poured truly. That is value too.
description_reversed_general: You may feel dry, as if the cup is empty. Do not force delight. First a drop: music, a tear, a talk. The spring often returns when you stop calling it with a shout.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship fear of opening is understandable. Open a finger width, not a flood. The heart likes to be welcomed slowly.
description_reversed_work: At work a lack of emotional meaning tires more than a lack of coffee. Look for one task at which something in you softens. From there it rebuilds.

name: Two of Cups
description_general: You may feel a bridge from heart to heart today. It is mutuality, a toast, a quiet yes. It does not have to be a grand gesture. It is enough that two people truly see each other. You were made for such exchange.
description_love: In love this card is a hand offered and a hand that takes it. Celebrate chemistry and respect at once. A pair that can bow to each other can also love.
description_work: In work and money partnership, chemistry in collaboration, an agreement signed with liking are favored. Choose people with whom you feel a level field. Together you will carry more than in a solo full of grievance.
description_reversed_general: You may feel no mirror or an uneven feeling. That stings. Do not chase by force. Look for a place where the toast is sweet for both sides.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a cooling of the bridge can be named. Ask for one honest, mutual gesture. A bridge is repaired from the middle span.
description_reversed_work: At work an alliance may wobble. Return to why you raised cups together at all. The meaning of the work together can matter more than ego.

name: Three of Cups
description_general: You may need laughter in a threesome, a foursome, a circle today. Friendship is a feast too. Raise a cup for not having to carry life alone. Shared joy heals shame and isolation.
description_love: In love a bond likes kind eyes around it. Or friendship warms into something more. Enjoy the people who cheer for you. Love does not have to be an island.
description_work: In work and money a team, celebrating a stage, meetings with heart are favored. Not everything must be a transaction. A cup offered in kindness returns.
description_reversed_general: You may feel outside the circle or that the feast is thin. That hurts. Look for one person with whom the toast is real. A crowd is not the only form of belonging.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship envy of time given to friends may appear. Talk about the need for community and the need for two. You can have both.
description_reversed_work: At work being left out of the coffee and gossip circuit hurts. Build your own small trio of trust. Work then tastes different.

name: Four of Cups
