description_general: You may sit with eyes down, missing what life offers at the side. This is not a whim. It is fullness or sadness. Give yourself the right to want nothing for a while. Then lift the gaze an inch. Sometimes a gift is quiet and waiting.
description_love: In love you may have no appetite for what is here, or compare it with what is not. Say that honestly. A partner cannot guess your cup if you only look at the ground.
description_work: In work and money apathy may hide a decent offer. You do not have to leap with joy. Check whether you refuse from wisdom or from numbness.
description_reversed_general: You may feel empty, as if nothing tastes. That is an important signal, not a flaw of character. Rest from choices. Taste returns when body and heart receive quiet.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship emotional absence hurts both. If you are the one in fog, name the fog. If it is the other person, do not stand with a cup in the air forever.
description_reversed_work: At work a lack of drive after many efforts is human. Change the angle, not necessarily the whole life. Sometimes other light on the same table is enough.

name: Five of Cups
description_general: You see what spilled, and that is honest. Grief has a right to be. When you are ready, turn a little. Behind you still stand cups that life did not take. You do not have to rejoice yet. It is enough to know that not everything is lost.
description_love: In love you may mourn how it was supposed to be. That is a real mourning. Do not build a whole house on spilled wine. There is still a talk, a remnant of a bridge, or the freedom to leave with dignity.
description_work: In work and money a loss, a mistake, a failed plan hurts. Count also what remains: a skill, a contact, tomorrow. Grief and accounting can walk together.
description_reversed_general: You may not be able to look away from what fell. Stay with the grief as long as you need, but not alone. One witness of your sadness changes the chemistry of the night.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship a grievance about the past may hide the living person beside you. Say what you regret and ask whether there is still something to save.
description_reversed_work: At work flushing with shame over a mistake lengthens the fall. Take the lesson, lean on what is whole, take a step.

name: Six of Cups
description_general: The scent of an old kindness may return: a memory, the child in you, someone from the past with a flower in hand. Receive that warmth. Not everything old is a trap. Sometimes it is a spring from which the adult can drink.
description_love: In love a return, forgiveness, tenderness without armor is possible. Or the bond needs play and simplicity, as once, before everything grew so serious. Give yourselves that innocence on purpose.
description_work: In work and money a return to the motive that started you, or work with someone known, can help. Roots feed. You do not have to be only new. You can be continuity.
description_reversed_general: You may linger in the past or idealize what is gone. Stroke the memory and come back to today room. The child in you wants to be taken into now, not left in an old house.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship comparing the present with an old version of you both hurts. Take the flavor from the past, not the chains of a script.
description_reversed_work: At work nostalgia for an old place may halt growth. Keep the lesson, release the building. Your craft travels with you.

name: Seven of Cups
description_general: Many cups may float before you: visions, temptations, mists of desire. That is beautiful and misleading. Put one foot on the ground. Choose the cup that has the weight of reality, not only shine. A dream likes to be chosen, not only watched.
description_love: In love you may project a whole cinema onto someone. Or stand before several roads of the heart. Lift the pink fog for a moment. Love a person, not a mirage. Then the choice grows simpler.
description_work: In work and money there may be too many options. Not all of them are real. Test one in practice. A fantasy of everything at once leaves you with nothing in hand.
description_reversed_general: You may feel drunk on possibility or paralyzed. Come down from the cloud to one question: what is real this month? The rest of the visions can wait in the lobby.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship promises without a body tire. Ask for one concrete. Stop feeding yourself on potential alone as well.
description_reversed_work: At work scattering among visions kills the harvest. Choose one cup for this season. Mastery begins with letting five others go.

name: Eight of Cups
description_general: You may turn from what was once full and is empty at the center now. That is brave and sad at once. You go looking for deeper water. You do not have to spit on what you leave. You can thank it and walk.
description_love: In love leaving, emotional or literal, may be an act of truth. If you stay, stay because of life, not habit. The heart knows when a cup is empty.
description_work: In work and money you may leave a role that no longer feeds the soul, even if it looks full from outside. Look for meaning. Safety matters, but it is not the only thing. Go in a way that lets you sleep.
description_reversed_general: You may fear leaving or feel guilt that you want more depth. That is not betrayal. That is loyalty to your own life. Take the first quiet step into the night. The path will show under the foot.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship silent leaving wounds. If you go, say at least a sentence. If you stay, return for real, not only in the body.
description_reversed_work: At work staying from habit is a road too. Ask what you seek on top of that hill. Then count the cost of leaving and of staying. Both numbers deserve respect.

name: Nine of Cups
description_general: You may feel the fullness of a wish that came true, or the right to wish. This is a quiet yes from life. Receive pleasure without negotiation. You are a guest in your own house of feeling and you may sit comfortably.
description_love: In love this card smells of contentment, tenderness of body and heart, an evening where nothing must be proven. Enjoy each other. Gratitude is the best wine here.
description_work: In work and money satisfaction with a result or with comfort you arranged for yourself may arrive. Celebrate. Do not cut the joy with a sentence that it is too little. For the nervous system it is a lot.
description_reversed_general: You may feel the fullness is empty or that one cup is still missing. That is human. Thank the nine. The tenth will not come faster from ingratitude.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship one person contentment may leave the other behind the table. Share the feast. Happiness likes two chairs.
description_reversed_work: At work comfort may lull growth. Enjoy, then decide whether you want another flavor or this quiet. Both answers are adult.

name: Ten of Cups
description_general: You may feel that the heart has a roof and a sky at once. This is a picture of an emotional home: not perfect, but alive. Wish yourself such fullness and recognize it in an ordinary day, not only in a rainbow on a card.
description_love: In love this card speaks of an emotional yes, a family of choice, being safe in feeling. Celebrate what you already know how to give each other. The rainbow is also after a fight, when you come back to each other.
description_work: In work and money harmony in a team, or a sense that work feeds home life, is real wealth. Guard that balance. A success that spoils the home is expensive.
description_reversed_general: You may long for such a picture and feel your life is far from it. Longing is a compass, not a verdict. Build one plank of roof at a time. Fullness arrives in layers.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship pressure to look like a postcard spoils an ordinary day. Allow imperfect tenderness. That is the ten.
description_reversed_work: At work a clash between career and the heart of home asks for a talk and a boundary. You can want both. You do not have to sacrifice one in silence.

name: Page of Cups
description_general: A tender, a little awkward voice of the heart may speak in you: a poem, a dream, a strange message from the soul. Listen. Not everything has to be grown to be true. Your sensitivity is a letter, not a flaw.
description_love: In love you may receive or send a shy, honest sign. Take it like a shell with a secret. Do not analyze it to death. Answer just as softly.
description_work: In work and money intuition and a creative impulse want to be taken seriously, even if they look impractical. Write it down. Try it small. Sometimes a strange shell holds a road.
description_reversed_general: You may be ashamed of your sensitivity or feel too childlike. That is an old judge. The Page of Cups has a right to a tear and to wonder. You do not have to harden to be taken seriously.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship extra sensitivity may meet someone else pace. Say that your heart hears a lot. Ask for a gentle voice, not for a change of the whole person.
description_reversed_work: At work an idea from the heart may be laughed at by hurry. Protect it before you put it on the market. A sketch likes quiet.

name: Knight of Cups
description_general: You may ride through the day with a cup in hand, like someone carrying an offer of the heart. That is romantic and serious at once. Go toward what you love with grace. Watch that the gesture has substance. A promise with water in the cup should arrive full.
description_love: In love this card favors a proposal of the soul: a letter, an invitation, a coming closer. Let feeling lead and check whether the road runs both ways. A knight who listens is more beautiful than a knight who only recites.
description_work: In work and money create with taste and empathy. An offer made with heart stands out. Do not sell fog. Carry a cup, not a mirage.
description_reversed_general: You may feel disappointed that a gesture was not received, or that you promise more than you can carry. Dismount and check the water level. Then ride on more truly.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship idealizing may fall from the horse. Stay with the person, not with the poem. Everyday tenderness is knighthood.
description_reversed_work: At work uplift without a plan spills. Attach one concrete step to the vision. Then the cup will arrive.

name: Queen of Cups
description_general: You may be deep water today: feeling, holding, understanding without words. Your empathy is a temple. Remember the shore. A queen who does not drown in other waves can truly heal. Your feelings are wise when they have a vessel.
description_love: In love this card favors deep listening and tender presence. You can love so that someone thaws. Watch that you have a place to thaw too. Mutuality includes care for the soul.
description_work: In work and money your sense of people is capital. Create spaces where feeling is allowed. Do not give all of yourself for atmosphere. Heart-work deserves frames and pay too.
description_reversed_general: You may be flooded by emotions, yours or others. Come to the shore. A queen sets the cup down for the night. Tomorrow she will be deep again. Today she can simply be a person who needs quiet.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship carrying all of a partner feelings ends in quiet anger. Give them their water back. Stay with yours. That is mature love.
description_reversed_work: At work being a container for team moods burns you out. Decide when you listen and when you close the office of the soul. A boundary is ethical.

name: King of Cups
description_general: You may hold great water in calm today, not because you feel nothing, but because you can feel and still stand. That is maturity of the heart. Your presence steadies storms. Lead with empathy and a spine. The world needs such kings, not hard ones, deep ones.
description_love: In love this card speaks of a partner who does not flee a wave. You can be that person. You can also meet one. Closeness likes someone who neither drowns in feeling nor shuts it out.
description_work: In work and money leading people with heart, negotiating in tension, art, conversation, anything where feeling meets responsibility is favored. Hold the helm. Do not pretend the sea is always smooth. Know how to be on it.
description_reversed_general: You may mute your own waves to keep peace on deck. That costs. Go below and feel. A king who admits a tear does not lose the crown. He gains truth.
description_reversed_love: In a relationship being always calm may be read as distance. Show a little of your water. A partner wants to know you, not only your steering.
description_reversed_work: At work carrying a whole team emotions without support is too much. Ask for an ally. Even a king drinks from someone else cup when the voyage is long.
